event.name: Elk Grove Lunar New Year Tết
event.dates: Feb 13–14, 2027 · 11 AM–5 PM · to be finalized

gifts.name: Festival Foundation
gifts.tagline: Insurance, permits, and infrastructure every festival needs.
gifts.description: CGL insurance, CCSD permit + TFF coordinator, transport and traffic, ops tents, organic digital marketing, volunteer hospitality, and festival coordination — embedded in the MVP cap.
benefits: Foundation sponsor recognition on website + email

gifts.name: Outdoor Stage
gifts.tagline: Main outdoor stage — PA, sound engineer, power, weather sidings, and two lion dances.
gifts.description: APEX trailer stage with ADA ramp, stage sidings for rain and wind protection, weekend PA and sound engineer (daylight hours), site generators for daylight power, and 2 lion dances (Sat + Sun, outdoor).

gifts.name: Indoor Stage
gifts.tagline: Rented indoor riser — PA, sound engineer, and Sunday programming.
gifts.description: Rented stage riser with indoor PA, power, and sound engineer for day 2 programming.

gifts.name: Safe Festival
gifts.tagline: Peak guards and pro traffic direction for a crowded two-day park festival.
gifts.description: Private security at peak hours Sat–Sun 11 AM–5 PM — crowd safety on festival grounds plus traffic and parking direction at entries and crossings. Daylight MVP staffing (no evening post).
benefits: Safety sponsor recognition on website + email

gifts.name: Festival Amenities
gifts.tagline: Restrooms, hand-wash, and pro trash crew — volunteers handle simple litter.
gifts.description: Restrooms and hand-wash stations through 5 PM close, plus hired porters and trash collectors for heavy and gross waste. Volunteer crews pick up simple litter only — not bins, kitchens, or restrooms.
benefits: Named amenity sponsor on website + digital sponsor slide

gifts.name: Parade+
gifts.tagline: Marching band, hired units, and day-of parade production — a parade worth watching.
gifts.description: Paid parade performers and hired units, plus parade production polish: route staging, lineup and spacing, MC/cue coordination, and unit check-in — the ops that turn hired performers into a coherent parade. Without Parade+, there is no parade at MVP.

gifts.name: Decor
gifts.tagline: Lanterns, stage flowers, and site accents — visual Tết atmosphere across the park.
gifts.description: Site decor registry block: lanterns, pole and entrance accents, stage flowers, and install labor — what families photograph on the grounds. Parade route production lives under Parade Performers.
benefits: Logo on decor assets photographed for social

gifts.name: Spread the Word
gifts.tagline: Spread the Word presented by [Sponsor] — reach families who have not found us yet.
gifts.description: Paid Facebook/Instagram and boosted posts — media sponsorship, not a petty-cash ask. No print posters.

gifts.name: Honor our Elders
gifts.tagline: Shade tents, seating, and elder tea hospitality — a place for grandparents to rest.
gifts.description: Named elder hospitality zone with shade, seating, and tea service. Not in MVP ops — grass fallback without sponsor.

gifts.name: Cây nêu (Tết Pole)
gifts.tagline: Traditional centerpiece — the pole families gather around at Tết.
gifts.description: Traditional Tết pole centerpiece. 2027 community pool pilot — materials, decor labor, and volunteer hospitality.
benefits: Named on website + Facebook/Instagram unlock post

gifts.name: Saturday Night Headliner
gifts.tagline: Sat 5–8 PM — evening ops, light towers, AV, headliner, and MC.
gifts.description: Saturday night extension with evening ops, outdoor stage light towers, evening AV, headliner, and MC — not ops-only empty hours.

gifts.name: Paris By Night Style Revue
gifts.tagline: ~2-hour produced variety show — singers, comedy, cultural numbers, MC.
gifts.description: Talent booking for a signature PBN-style revue on the MVP stage — singers, comedy, cultural acts, and MC. Assumes baseline stage, PA, and sound engineers; add Covered Main Stage for upgraded sound, lights, LED, and weather tent.

gifts.name: Lucky Wav Edition
gifts.tagline: Younger-skewed stage block — DJs, R&B, rap, dance.
gifts.description: Named Lucky Wav stage segment — one selectable programming block among PBN revue, Sat night headliner, and other talent sponsors.

gifts.name: Asian Cajun Show
gifts.tagline: ~2–3 hour programming block — Gulf Coast bands, fusion acts, and MC.
gifts.description: Booked Asian Cajun / Louisiana lineup on the MVP indoor or outdoor stage — existing PA and sound engineers are in core ops. Zydeco, R&B, and fusion acts for a 2–3 hour show block, like the programming families gathered around at Asian Cajun Village in 2026.

gifts.name: Covered Main Stage
gifts.tagline: Walled tent + LED + concert PA — the outdoor main stage weather shell.
gifts.description: Turns the outdoor main stage into a covered venue: large frame tent with walls (rain/wind protection for audience and LED), concert-quality PA, stage lights, and LED wall. Daytime programming (lion dance, youth, music) and Saturday night headliner share this shell; Sunday evening Big Game Outdoor Evening is a separate add-on that reuses the same LED. Assumes core Outdoor Stage (APEX/riser, baseline engineer, daylight generators) is already in MVP.

lineItems.label: Walled frame tent — main stage audience shell (rental, walls, weights, install)

gifts.name: Children's Show
gifts.tagline: Kids stage — short sets parents can actually sit through.
gifts.description: Sac County Fair Kids Zone model — **30–45 min blocks, 2–3 sets per day** on the family stage (local magic, storytelling, puppetry, character participation). Participation beats spectacle; not a headliner stack. Assumes baseline stage, PA, and sound engineers in core ops. Pair with **Children's Village** (in-ground activities + anchor hosts), **Youth Culture Day** (school multicultural rallies), and **Tết Relay Cup** (open-age relay bracket — see `tet_relay_cup`).

lineItems.label: Magic sets ×2 (45 min each — local fair acts)

gifts.name: Meme Dance Contest
gifts.tagline: A drop-in dance challenge — a high schooler leads from the stage, kids follow on the floor.
gifts.description: Short, low-pressure dance heats built around current, family-safe songs and choreography kids recognize from their feeds. A high school dance-crew leader teaches the moves from the stage while kids follow along on the floor — no experience needed, just jump in — then heats let anyone who wants the spotlight compete. A DJ and host keep the energy up, the crowd cheers, and small prizes keep it playful. Includes a public-performance licensing allowance; final music coverage must be confirmed against the selected songs before the event.

lineItems.label: Dance floor markings, signage + check-in supplies

gifts.name: Moditional Dance Battle
gifts.tagline: Modern-meets-traditional crew battle — schools remix áo dài, lion, and fan with hip-hop and K-pop.
gifts.description: **Moditional Dance Battle** — the 2027 format for the **Youth Culture Day** lane. **EGUSD high school** crews and cultural clubs compete head-to-head in a judged bracket, but every routine must **fuse modern + traditional** (áo dài, lion, fan, or heritage movement remixed with hip-hop / K-pop / cover). Scoring blends a **light panel** with a **crowd-hype meter**, so the audience has a job. **Participation guardrail:** between rounds, a near-peer leader runs an **open-floor learn-along** (shared with the Meme Dance Contest mechanic) so little kids and families jump in — not a watch-only stage. **Medals + traveling title to crews, no individual crowning** — celebrates craft, not a pageant pedestal. **Pan-APIDA / multicultural** — open to all school clubs, not VN-only. Battle crews also supply the near-peer leaders for the Meme Dance Contest. **Separate from Tết Relay Cup** (grass athletics) and the **Meme Dance Contest** (under-12 follow-along). College / campus orgs route to **Sac State APIDA LNY**.
benefits: Facebook/Instagram feature + school tags on the bracket grid
MC thank-you for participating schools + crew photo-op

lineItems.label: Crew prize pool + traveling title / medals
DJ + hype MC/host (battle energy + open-floor learn-along calls)
Judging panel hospitality + scoring / run-of-show admin
Public-performance music licensing allowance (confirm vs final tracks)
Open participation floor, crew staging, bracket signage + program

gifts.name: Tết Relay Cup
gifts.tagline: Open-age relay bracket — clubs, leagues, and community teams on the grass.
gifts.description: **Tết Relay Cup** — festival-run **relay tournament** on the grass corral beside Children's Village. **Not a youth-only product** — open **age brackets** (adult rec, parish teams, school clubs, service orgs). **2027 MVP:** one featured bracket (often HS-heavy); expand divisions as registration fills. Single-elimination heats, East/West or age pools, prizes to winning teams. **Youth Culture Day** (stage rallies) is a **separate registry block** — schools may do both. College org performance routes to Sac State APIDA LNY.
benefits: Facebook/Instagram feature + public bracket on website program
MC thank-you for participating schools and clubs
Traveling trophy + prize checks to winning club accounts

lineItems.label: Prize pool — champion, runner-up, division split, spirit
Relay facilitator + East/West bracket ops + corral supplies

gifts.name: Children's Village
gifts.tagline: Shade, activities, anchor hosts — families regroup and kids do Tết.
gifts.description: **Family home base** — compact zone with shade, stroller corral, benches, and cultural **do** stations (lantern craft, red-envelope play, scavenger). **Anchor hosts** run repeat parent–toddler sessions (bilingual sing-along, story circle — a person families already know, not an empty org tent). **Turnkey activations** for gyms/PTAs: partner forwards one email; festival runs the slot. **Family meetup corral** with labeled stations on the map. Adjacent to Tết Relay Cup corral. **Bounce house rentals** (vendor) and **owned inflatable carnival games** (deploy labor) are **separate registry blocks** — same **Children's Village** director when funded. Not in MVP ops.
benefits: Named on activity signage + festival map

lineItems.label: Family meetup corral — signage, map pin, labeled stations
Anchor host sessions (2 curated hosts × weekend stipends)

gifts.name: Bounce House Rentals
gifts.tagline: Rented bounce houses — vendor delivers, sets up, and hauls away.
gifts.description: **Vendor rental only** — not the coalition-owned inflatable carnival games in storage. Party-rental company delivers bounce houses for the weekend, handles setup/teardown and cleaning, and takes them back. **Children's Village** director books the vendor and zone layout; **Foundation** director confirms **CGL covers inflatables** (or rider increment below) and collects **vendor COI** naming the coalition before go. Bounce houses typically **change insurance requirements** — do not unlock without Foundation sign-off.
benefits: Named on play-zone signage + festival map

lineItems.label: Bounce house rentals ×2 (weekend — delivery, setup, teardown, vendor clean)
Safety mats / perimeter if not in rental
CGL review / rider increment for inflatables (Foundation confirms quote)

gifts.name: Inflatable Carnival Games
gifts.tagline: Our 8-station carnival games — funded deploy labor, not a rental fee.
gifts.description: cPALSs + VACOS **already own** the Magic Jump–class **8-station inflatable games** bundle ([product reference](https://www.magicjump.com/blog/inflatable-carnival-games/)). This block pays **deploy cost only** — U-Haul trailer, setup/teardown crew (meals or hired hands), cleaning, **6K portable generator + weekend fuel** (not a site-scale rental — coordinate with Power & Lighting if sharing), and **storage amortization** (U-Haul unit rent ÷ 3 flagship events). **Not** bounce houses (separate rental block). **Children's Village** director runs the zone.
benefits: Named on game-station signage + festival map

lineItems.label: Setup + teardown labor (hired hands or volunteer crew meals)
Storage amortization — games share (2 pallets ÷ 3 flagships; Elk Grove U-Haul)

gifts.name: Fashion Garden
gifts.tagline: An all-weekend heritage-fashion garden — dress up, promenade, and take the family photo.
gifts.description: Replaces the competitive pageant with an open, family-facing fashion experience in the Pavilion: styled garden photo sets, áo dài ambassadors, public dress-up participation, rotating lighthearted contests, and a walking parade corps. Composed with Viet Cafe so parents can linger while families rotate through the sets. No crowning, interviews, dedicated stage, or booked show stack.
benefits: Naming credit on photo-set and Pavilion signage

gifts.name: Viet Cafe
gifts.tagline: A warm Pavilion oasis — Vietnamese coffee, boba, seating, and charging for parents.
gifts.description: An all-day parent-respite cafe composed with Fashion Garden in the Pavilion. A beverage vendor sells Vietnamese coffee, boba, and family drinks while this gift funds the shared environment: comfortable seating, cafe tables, charging, warm lighting, and decor. The cafe is the function; Fashion Garden is the photo-rich setting. If Pavilion space is tight, Viet Cafe keeps indoor priority as winter-weather insurance.
benefits: Naming credit on cafe and charging-area signage

lineItems.label: Cafe tables, lounge seating + family regroup area
Safe guest charging stations + power distribution
Warm lighting, menu boards + cafe decor

gifts.name: Community Yearbook Photo Set
gifts.tagline: One annual whole-community portrait — free, open, and built for the archive.
gifts.description: A scheduled all-community group portrait at the festival — the rare open gathering where families, organizations, and generations can appear in one frame. Funds a professional photographer, wide backdrop / group markers, an elevated camera position subject to CCSD approval, and crowd coordination. Delivers a high-resolution annual artifact for families, archives, sponsor decks, and grant reach reporting. Distinct from Fashion Garden's individual photo sets and áo dài corps portrait.
benefits: Sponsor credit with the published annual portrait

lineItems.label: Wide backdrop, group markers + photo signage
Timed gather, crowd coordination + accessibility support

gifts.name: Big Game Pavilion Watch

gifts.description: Indoor Big Game watch in the Pavilion on Sunday evening Feb 14, 2027 — the weatherproof alternate if Covered Main Stage is not funded.
